messages:
amanda: Heads-up — main is failing CI on linux-py310-unit. I think it started after yesterday's dependency updates.

amanda: Error from test run:
```
E   ImportError: cannot import name 'JWTError' from 'jwt' (/opt/hostedtoolcache/.../site-packages/jwt/__init__.py)

tests/test_auth.py::test_token_decode FAILED
```

amanda: Full job: https://ci.example.com/job/12345 (logs attached) :grimacing:

josh: Which dependency update? lockfile changed in the same PR or a separate one?

amanda: Separate PR — infra/dep-bumps/2026-03-12. poetry.lock diff shows PyJWT bumped from 2.6.0 -> 3.0.0 (transitive via authn-client).

priya: PyJWT 3.x is breaking the import path and renamed some exceptions. We pinned to 2.6 in a couple services last month. Might need to pin it in the monorepo to keep tests stable.

nate: Can we reproduce locally with the lock from main? Amanda, can you paste the failing venv pip freeze or the traceback full path?

amanda: Attached the failure lines and the pip list from the runner. Confirmed PyJWT==3.0.0 in site-packages on the runner.

josh: Quick triage options: 1) revert the dep-bump PR, 2) add an explicit dependency "PyJWT = \"2.6.0\"" to pyproject (forces poetry to pin), or 3) update our auth code to be compatible with 3.x. 1 is fastest if the bump is unnecessary.

priya: I can open a tiny PR to add an explicit pin in pyproject.toml for now (keeps runtime stable). Also add a comment explaining transitive bump.

amanda: That would be great. Would a lock regen be needed? We should avoid updating other transitive pins — just do ``poetry lock --no-update`` after changing pyproject so lockfile records the explicit constraint.

nate: Alternatively, we can run a lockfile bisect job to find which dep introduced PyJWT 3.0.0 and see if we can adjust that one. But adding explicit pin is the quickest stopgap.

josh: Amanda, can you re-run the failing job after Priya's PR lands? CI bot will pick it up but a manual rerun helps.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered for job 12345 by @amanda — queued.

priya: Opening PR now: infra/patches/pin-pyjwt-2.6.0. Will include instructions and a follow-up todo to investigate migration to 3.x.

amanda: Thanks — will monitor. If CI still fails after the pin, we'll do a bisect. :eyes:

josh: Heads-up to oncall: if this turns into a wider rollback we'll coordinate.

nate: If anyone wants me to run the bisect job I can kick it off after the pin if things are still red.

amanda: Update: PR merged, lock updated with --no-update, re-running linux-py310-unit now.

ci-bot: Job 12345 re-run completed — SUCCESS.

amanda: Green now. Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem note in #postmortems for tracking follow-up (investigate upstream authn-client bump).
